UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the Bracket Battles application, storing personal details, financial ledger, virtual currency, and referral information. Authentication is handled by an external system (Firebase Auth).

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

firebaseAuthUid.description: Unique identifier from the Firebase Authentication system, linking to the external authentication system.

mobileNumber.description: The user's mobile phone number, used for authentication (OTP) and administrative search/filter.

deviceId.description: Unique identifier of the user's device (e.g., IMEI/Android ID), used for restricting multiple accounts per device and user management.

registrationDate.description: The date and time when the user registered their account.

totalDeposit.description: The cumulative total amount of money the user has deposited into their account.

totalWithdrawal.description: The cumulative total amount of money the user has withdrawn from their account.

downlineIncome.description: The cumulative income earned by the user from their referred users (downline), as part of the referral rewards system.

coins.description: The current balance of virtual currency ('coins') the user possesses, earned from Offer Wall tasks and used for tournament entry fees.

referredByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who referred this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserProfile)

isAdmin.description: A flag indicating whether the user has administrative privileges.

Tournament.title: Tournament
Tournament.description: Represents a competition or series of matches in the Bracket Battles application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tournament entity.

name.description: The official name of the tournament.

description.description: A detailed description of the tournament, including rules, format, and prize information.

status.description: The current status of the tournament (e.g., 'Upcoming', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Canceled').

startDate.description: The scheduled start date and time of the tournament.

endDate.description: The scheduled end date and time of the tournament.

entryFeeCoins.description: The amount of virtual currency (coins) required for a user to enter this tournament.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a single match within a tournament, displaying live scores, status, and player/team information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

tournamentId.description: Reference to the Tournament entity this match belongs to. (Relationship: Tournament 1:N Match)

player1Name.description: The name of the first player or team participating in the match.

player2Name.description: The name of the second player or team participating in the match.

score1.description: The current or final score for Player/Team 1.

score2.description: The current or final score for Player/Team 2.

status.description: The current status of the match (e.g., 'Scheduled', 'Live', 'Completed', 'Postponed').

startTime.description: The scheduled start date and time of the match.

endTime.description: The actual or estimated end date and time of the match, recorded once the match concludes.

aiInsight.description: AI-generated summary or insight for the match, based on match data.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: Represents a user's vote on a match outcome, favorite player, or other predefined tournament elements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vote entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity of the user who cast the vote. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Vote)

matchId.description: Reference to the Match entity this vote is cast for. (Relationship: Match 1:N Vote)

votedForPlayerName.description: The name of the player or team the user voted for (e.g., 'Player1 Name' or 'Player2 Name' from the associated Match).

voteTimestamp.description: The date and time when the vote was cast.

ReferralReward.title: ReferralReward
ReferralReward.description: Tracks the status and details of rewards earned by users for referring new players.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ReferralReward entity.

referrerUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who made the referral. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ReferralReward)

referredUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who was referred. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ReferralReward)

referralDate.description: The date and time when the referral occurred.

rewardAmountCoins.description: The amount of virtual currency (coins) awarded to the referrer upon successful referral conditions.

isRewardClaimed.description: A boolean indicating if the reward has been claimed by the referrer.

referredUserMadeFirstPaidEntry.description: A boolean indicating if the referred user has completed their first paid tournament entry, triggering reward eligibility.

OfferWallActivity.title: OfferWallActivity
OfferWallActivity.description: Records a user's activity and earnings from completing tasks on the CPA Lead Offer Wall.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OfferWallActivity entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity of the user who completed the offer. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N OfferWallActivity)

offerName.description: The name or title of the offer completed from the CPA Lead Offer Wall.

offerDescription.description: A brief description of the offer that was completed.

rewardCoins.description: The amount of virtual currency (coins) earned by the user for completing this offer.

completionDate.description: The date and time when the offer was marked as completed.

status.description: The current status of the offer completion (e.g., 'Pending', 'Completed', 'Rejected').

externalOfferId.description: An optional identifier from the external CPA Lead system for tracking purposes.

AppSetting.title: AppSetting
AppSetting.description: Stores global application settings and configurations, such as maintenance mode status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppSetting entity (e.g., 'MAINTENANCE_MODE_ENABLED', 'PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_STATUS').

settingName.description: A human-readable name for the application setting.

settingValue.description: The value of the setting, stored as a string. This can represent boolean, numeric, or textual values depending on the setting type.

description.description: A clear description of what this application setting controls.

lastUpdatedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the administrator who last updated this setting. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AppSetting)

lastUpdatedAt.description: The date and time when this setting was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profile data. The document ID `{userId}` corresponds to the Firebase Authentication UID (`UserProfile.firebaseAuthUid`), enabling direct path-based access and ownership checks. Includes `isAdmin` for global role-based access control.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the user, serving as the document ID for their profile.

definition.description: Collection of votes cast by a specific user on various match outcomes. The `userId` in the path matches `Vote.userId` (denormalized) for robust ownership-based security.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the user who cast the vote.

params.name: voteId
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific user's vote.

definition.description: Collection of referral rewards earned by this user as a referrer. The `userId` in the path matches `ReferralReward.referrerUserId` (denormalized) for clear ownership and authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the referrer user.

params.name: rewardId
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific referral reward.

definition.description: Collection of Offer Wall activities completed by this user. The `userId` in the path matches `OfferWallActivity.userId` (denormalized) for robust ownership-based security.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the user who completed the offer.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific Offer Wall activity.

Subcollection of matches belonging to a specific tournament. Publicly readable. Writable only by administrators for score updates. Includes `tournamentId` (denormalized) for authorization independence.

params.name: tournamentId
params.description: Unique identifier for the parent tournament.

params.name: matchId
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific match within the tournament.

definition.description: Global application settings and configurations (e.g., maintenance mode). Publicly readable by all users. Writable only by administrators.

params.name: settingId
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific application setting (e.g., 'MAINTENANCE_MODE_ENABLED').

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and DBAC, prioritizing simple and robust security rules. 

**Authorization Independence:**
1.  **User-specific data:** All user-owned subcollections (`/users/{userId}/votes`, `/users/{userId}/referralRewards`, `/users/{userId}/offerWallActivities`) embed the `userId` directly in the path. The documents within these subcollections (`Vote.userId`, `ReferralReward.referrerUserId`, `OfferWallActivity.userId`) also contain a denormalized reference to the owning user's ID. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls to parent documents for authorization, as rules can simply compare `request.auth.uid` with the path's `userId` segment and the document's denormalized `userId` field, enabling atomic writes and simplified debugging.
2.  **Tournament and Match data:** `Match` documents include the `tournamentId` field. This ensures that a `Match` document can be understood and authorized in isolation if needed, preventing dependencies on `get()` calls to the parent `Tournament` document for its core identification or relationship. For public read access, this denormalization is less about preventing `get()` and more about clarity and potential future rule complexity.
3.  **Admin Roles (DBAC):** The `UserProfile.isAdmin` field is used to grant administrative privileges. While checking this field requires a `get()` call to the user's *own* profile (`/users/$(request.auth.uid)`), this is an acceptable and common pattern for self-authorization based on database-stored roles, as it's directly tied to `request.auth.uid` rather than a separate, unrelated parent document. This approach adheres to the mandate of storing roles in the database and relying solely on `request.auth.uid` for authorization, avoiding external Firebase Auth custom claims.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
1.  **Public Collections:** The `/tournaments` and `/tournaments/{tournamentId}/matches` collections are structured to be publicly readable. This allows clients to `list` documents directly without requiring security rules to filter the results, ensuring QAP compliance for public views like "Tournament Overview" and "Real-time Match Viewer."
2.  **User-Owned Data:** For private user data (`votes`, `referralRewards`, `offerWallActivities`), the `/users/{userId}` path segment inherently restricts access to the authenticated user (`request.auth.uid == userId`). This means `list` operations on these subcollections automatically only return data owned by the requesting user, making them QAP compliant as rules do not need to filter. 
3.  **Admin Access:** Administrators are granted broad `list` and `write` access to sensitive collections (e.g., all `/users` documents for "Admin User Search and Filter," or `AppSetting` for "Maintenance Mode Toggle") based on their `isAdmin` status. This is QAP compliant as the `list` operation is performed by an explicitly authorized role.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   User-specific and private data are strictly segregated under `/users/{userId}`.
*   Publicly viewable data (`Tournaments`, `Matches`) are in dedicated top-level collections or subcollections with consistent public read access.
*   Global application settings (`AppSetting`) are in their own collection with specific admin-only write access.
